decisions.decision: Conduct the employee climate survey every two years rather than annually, based on budgeting and implementation time.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to conduct the survey every two years instead of annually

decisions.decision: Aim to have climate survey results by November 1 to inform budget planning.
decisions.quote: they agreed to aim for having results by november 1st to inform budget planning.

decisions.decision: Distribute the climate survey electronically, with accommodations for accessibility; results analyzed by an independent third party.
decisions.quote: the board agreed the survey should be distributed electronically, with accommodations made for accessibility needs.

decisions.decision: Continue refining the climate survey policy, including reviewing sample questions from survey companies.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to continue refining the policy, including reviewing sample questions from survey companies.

decisions.decision: Gather more information on CPA exemptions, financial impacts and benefits before deciding whether to pursue adoption this year.
decisions.quote: the board agreed to gather more information on exemptions, financial impacts, and potential benefits before deciding whether to pursue cpa adoption this year.

decisions.decision: No action on 55 Carr Avenue; the Board needs more time to review the tax-foreclosure requirements.
decisions.quote: the board agreed they needed more time to review this comprehensive and complex information before deciding regarding 55 carr avenue.

decisions.decision: Tom Alonzo to meet the selected town manager candidate on the contract template and report back, requesting an executive session if needed.
decisions.quote: alonzo said he would report back to the board on the outcome and request an executive session if needed to finalize the contract.
